description: Jiang Wei, young upright chinese general in the supplied pixel art style. Black hair in a bun with a green headband and long green tails, silver lamellar armor over white and green cloth, a white scarf, dark boots. He holds a long spear with a silver leaf-shaped blade
face: A clear earnest young face, no beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the black hair bun with the green headband tails, silver armor, white and green cloth, the spear at his right side.
guard_action: both hands take the spear and bring it to a ready angle at the right side, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.idle: Spearman fighting guard, spear held in both hands, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the spear, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: HORIZONTAL spear sweep, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the whole upper body winds far to the right with the spear held level; frames 7-8 the spear swings around from the side to the front in a wide flat arc; frames 9-11 hold in front. The spear travels sideways, not a thrust. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: VERTICAL overhead spear strike. Frames 3-6 both hands raise the spear straight up above the head, pointing at the sky; frames 7-8 it is brought down from above onto the target; frames 9-11 hold with the tip low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Leaping downward spear strike. Frames 1-4 he sinks; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground with the spear over the right shoulder; frame 8 he lands driving the spear down; frames 9-11 absorb the landing. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s3: Northern campaign thrust. Frames 1-6 he sinks very low with the spear below the guard line; frame 8 one big rising thrust up into chest height; frames 9-12 hold the reach. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → b2 → a3, 전법 s3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
